defense_news.title: Swiss neutrality proponents challenge arms firms in vote on easing of exports
defense_news.summary: Swiss voters will decide on Nov. 29 whether to block a bill relaxing curbs on weapons exports, in a referendum that touches on Switzerland's evolving neutral tradition.

defense_news.title: European troops set to train in Poland for postwar Ukraine deployment
defense_news.summary: Britain and France will lead 2,800 troops from 11 nations in a two-week exercise testing how to move, protect and supply a force to rebuild Ukraine’s military after the war ends.

defense_news.title: US Army feeds culinary soldiers new job title
defense_news.summary: Formerly known as culinary specialists, a soldier with the 92G occupation identifier will henceforth be known as a “tactical field feeding specialist.”

defense_news.title: US, Colombian troops kick off exercise amid the Pentagon’s Western Hemisphere pivot
defense_news.summary: Hundreds of American and Colombian troops kicked off a sprawling military exercise in Colombia this week as the U.S. military sharpens its focus on the Western Hemisphere.

geo_news.title: AK Parti Genel Başkan Yardımcısı Zorlu, Rusya'nın Ankara Büyükelçisi Verşinin ile görüştü

geo_news.summary: Adana'nın Kozan ilçesinde saat 15.28'de 4,6 büyüklüğünde deprem meydana geldi.
